_README: Copy this file to config/target_accounts.json (which is gitignored) and fill in
real credentials. One object per owned Target account. relogin_one.py / harvest_accounts.py
read this file to log each account in and write its session to `session_path`, which
the existing WorkerPool then consumes (fleet auto-sizes to the enabled-account count).
Field reference:
account_id   - free-form label; also seeds this account's stable device fingerprint.
username     - Target login email.
password     - Target login password. (2FA is assumed OFF per current setup.)
cvv          - REQUIRED. This account's saved-card CVV (3-4 digits). Each account has a
DISTINCT card, so this MUST be set per account: with no valid cvv the bot
refuses to guess and checkout fails (it will NOT silently reuse another
account's code). Keep cards + billing addresses distinct per account.
session_path - where harvested cookies are written. The 1st ENABLED account keeps the
legacy 'target.json'; the Nth enabled account uses 'target-{N}.json'.
Numbering is by ENABLED position (matches WorkerPool). RECOMMENDED: set
this explicitly on every account so disabling one never shifts the rest.
profile_dir  - this account's dedicated Chrome user-data dir. 1st enabled = 'nodriver-profile';
Nth enabled = 'nodriver-profile-{N}'. Each account MUST have its own profile.
RECOMMENDED: set explicitly (same reason as session_path).
proxy_url    - OPTIONAL. Per-account exit IP; MUST be unique per account (two accounts on
one BD IP correlate + share the single-IP 429). Leave empty for home IP.
Bright Data ISP URLs need the local forwarder (src/proxy/local_forwarder.py).
timezone     - OPTIONAL. IANA tz to pin the fingerprint to the proxy's geo
(e.g. 'America/Chicago'). Empty = derived deterministically from account_id.
enabled      - set false to skip this account. If you disable one, set session_path/profile_dir
explicitly on the others so their default numbering does not shift.
notes        - free text for your own bookkeeping (card/address jigging, etc). NOT read by code.

accounts.notes: Existing working account. Keep on legacy paths for zero migration. Distinct card.
Second account. Distinct virtual card + jigged address + unique proxy_url.
Third account. Distinct card + unique proxy_url.
